metadataSchema.kind: Artifact content type. Here, html means the artifact is a standalone HTML document.
metadataSchema.renderer: Preview renderer used by the design host. Here, html means the host should render the entry as an HTML page.
metadataSchema.inferred: Metadata values were extracted automatically from the HTML artifact and surrounding project context.
metadataSchema.reconciled: The inferred values were checked against the current artifact entry and kept because they still match.
metadataSchema.inferredAndReconciled: When both flags are true, consumers may treat the metadata as generated but validated against the current artifact rather than manually authored.
